selection_method.scope: one selection per criterion within each model × dataset run
selection_method.candidate_filter: valid_samples > 0, invalid_samples = 0, finite change rate and entropy
selection_method.high_change: maximum distinct-sample change rate; entropy is the first tie-breaker
selection_method.high_entropy: maximum normalized four-state entropy; change rate is the first tie-breaker
selection_method.stable: minimum change rate, then minimum entropy, then maximum mean distance from the two class thresholds
selection_method.overlap_policy: criteria are independent; overlapping selections share one exported trace
